article_content: A formerly obese man is getting his teeth into a new challenge by running the London Marathon after shedding more than a quarter of his body weight. Paul Hinton, 38, from Stoke-on-Trent, once weighed 20st, but decided to get fit after joining a slimming club in April last year. The father of three has now lost 6st and has raised an impressive £2000 for Caudwell Children's charity in the process.
